leaf.scope: Manager decision-model mediation, host-derived allow_early_completion, and whether Engineer workspace-write sandbox revokes direct stage-machine mutation capability

primary_files.claim: normal orchestration declares Manager sole stage-transition authority, invokes the Manager model read-only, derives early-completion permission in host code, then applies the resulting decision via stage-machine primitives
workspace-write confines filesystem writes to project workdir plus allowlist and protects gate/package roots; it does not revoke Python import or callable capability

advance_stage explicitly states caller identity is not authenticated; complete_final_stage explicitly documents a prior Engineer direct import/call and says its early-completion argument is a lock, not a signature
holds_stage_authority=False prevents dispatched teammate work from reaching the normal stage-writer route

findings.allow_early_completion: verified_host_derived_in_normal_orchestration: not open_ended AND resolved workflow_mode == direct
findings.runtime_worker_route_guard: verified: holds_stage_authority=False blocks the normal dispatched-teammate transition path
findings.material_distinction: The safe filesystem sandbox protects gate/package code and other forbidden roots from writes, but the project workdir remains writable. The stage_machine module itself states that advance_stage does not authenticate the caller, and complete_final_stage states that a determined caller can still pass allow_early_completion. Therefore normal-path authority mediation and filesystem immutability must not be upgraded into a claim that Engineer capability to invoke mutation primitives has been revoked.
findings.residual_guard: advance_stage still runs the active vertical deterministic completion validator; complete_final_stage rejects non-final completion unless allow_early_completion=True, then also runs the completion validator. These are data/contract checks, not caller authentication.

phase1_gate_accounting.acceptance_effect: scope-correction evidence only; does not close any Phase-1 row or root
